INSERT INTO user_notification (
                notification_id,
                user_id,
                event_item_type,
                event_item_id,
                notification_event_type
            )
            SELECT $1, user_id, $3, $4, $5
            FROM UNNEST($2::text[]) as user_id
            RETURNING created_at::timestamptz as "created_at!"
